balls.text: he makes room to carve this full ball to deep cover for a couple

and this is a lovely bouncer. He has been mis-hit for two sixes by Dhoni, but this is aimed right at the melon. Dhoni backs away, and is in no position to pull. Manages a massive edge that settles with mid-off
cruel on the bowler again. He has done him in with the slower ball, but Dhoni has hit this over long-on for a big six with just one hand. These modern bats, I tell you

this is the Maxwell-type back-away-look-away-square-cut. Dhoni backs away to slog, he is late into the sot, but he has swung hard at it, and edges it over point for six. This is just cruel on the bowler
wide on the crease to bowl a yorker that cramps him up. Dug out for just a single
short ball, quick again, Dgoni late into the pull again. Just the single
down the wicket, again soft hands bunt it towards deep midwicket. Comes back for two

that's smart bowling. Tahir has anticipated Dhoni wants to go wide long-on and midwicket, and he bowls a slow loopy wide legbreak. It is away from Dhoni but not quite a wide. All Dhoni manages is a single to long-off
full, straight and fast, this time he will get just the single to long-on
another lovely shot by Ashwin, chips this legbreak over cover for another couple
googly, Ashwin is down the wicket, uses soft hands to bunt it into the leg side for a couple. Dhoni in no form to turn down that second
down the track but Tahir bowls full and flat, gives him no room, concedes just the single

lovely shot to break the maiden. This is just pure timing. Short of a length, Ashwin shuffles across to reach the line of the ball, and dabs it beautifully in front of third man and to the left of point. Superb timing to beat both of them
slower ball, on a length, into the pads, goes for a leg-bye. Dhoni 15 off 21
sharp bouncer, too quick for Dhoni's pull, is beaten over his left shoulder. Not given out as they put in a half shout, but that's four dots in a row
full and straight this time, and he has found midwicket. Three dots
short of a length, slower ball, his timing is off, and he has hit it straight to mid-off

skiddy quick short ball, Dhoni is late into the pull. Dhoni, who has of late made it a habit to sit back and wait for the bad balls, might have to hit the good ones here if he is going to get CSK a defendable target
short of a length, Ashwin looks to manufacture a pull. The ball is nearly not short enough. He can't get this off the square
short of a length, pretty straight, defended. This is a superb over from the debutant

skiddy ball and he out lbw. every batsman that Yuvraj misses gets out next ball. pretty straight, and just short of a length, and it skids through to beat him and trap him in front. Height is the only issue, but Vineet Kulkarni has raised his finger

short of a length, on off, opens the face, takes a single, but if Yuvraj hits from point Bravo is gone. Just the one stump to aim at so only a half chance. I suspect Dhoni called in Hindi. Saying "bhag". [Run]
pressure telling on Dhoni. Looks for a wide slog. That's not Dhoni. Wild slogging is not his game. The ball is in Chepauk, he is swinging in Nungambakkam. Beaten by a length ball
and he bowls a good first delivery. Quick, on a length, no room. Defended back to him
slower through the air, perfect dipping legbreak, defended in front of the body. Mishra 4-0-21-1
another defensive push to a legbreak, gets just the single to long-off
lovely legbreak, dipping on hi, just outside off, defended in front of the body
full, straight and fast, driven to long-on for one

well that was the plan with Jadeja to hit the leggie with the turn, except that Mishra turns this away. Jadeja hasn't been watching them out of the hand, which turns his advance down the wicket into a highly low-percentage shot. Beaten comprehensively by the googly, and is stumped by a mile
flat, front of the hands, punched to deep cover for one
flat quick delivery, just a bit short, Dhoni not looking to take any risks, and gets just the single to long-on despite playing it with soft hands
another shimmy, another quick ball, another dot as Dhoni pushes this straight to cover
Tahir fires this one as Dhoni shimmies down. No room. Hit back to Tahir
down the wicket to bunt this into the leg side. "Do, do, do" [Two, two, two] is the immediate call. And he has placed it superbly with soft hands. Gets two
full toss, gets away with a single to long-on. Jadeja just not looking to go big against Tahir
flighted outside off, pushed into the off side for a single
short ball, an effort ball, hurries Jadeja into the pull, hits the bat as opposed to the bat hitting the ball. A decent over from Morkel
short of a length, wide, punched to deep cover
Short ball, but that at Morkel's pace is a long hop. Dhoni rocks back and pulls him through midwicket for four
short of a length, holds its line outside off, he shuffles across to defend. Just gets too close to the line of the ball to be able to work it for one
Jadeja gets lucky with this one. Looks to open the front leg and slog, gets an outside edge for a single to third man
short of a length, no room, defended with an open face. A dot
stays back for this flat straighter delivery, and uses the pace to send it past backward point for two
slightly short, but he has no room to play the pull, and ends up slugging it to deep midwicket for one
offbreak, worked off the pads for a single
short of a length, worked to leg for a single that brings about another cheer. Dhoni is on strike now

the first special catch of the IPL, after eight drops. But it is a goodie from Shreyas Iyer, the Mumbai youngster. Du Plessis backs away again to go over extra, but is cramped up this time, which means he ends up hitting it mush straighter than he wants to. Iyer camps on the fence, and takes this coolly overhead
flat offbreak, du Plessis backs away, and punches it over extra cover for four
slider this time, and is punched down to long-off for one
Du Plessis backs away this time, but Mishra slows it down and bowls a lovely loopy legbreak to beat the outside edge
Mishra sees him come down the wicket, and bowls that slider from out of the front of the hand. Beats him in the flight and hits his pad
flighted outside off, driven to long-off for one
and now the crowd cheers. Jadeja leaves the crease again, and reaches the pitch of a legbreak to hit it for a six right back over Mishra's head
down the wicket, not quite to the pitch of the ball, and the crowd gets more restless with another dot
worked into the leg side for another couple. He is manipulating the field well
makes room to drive this towards deep cover where Joseph is done in by late spin away from him. Concedes that extra run
flighted this time, on off, it turns back in to cramp him up again, ekes out another dot
stays back to a length-ball offbreak, is cramped for room, and punches it straight to cover
long hop, and he is lucky Jadeja takes just the single to deep midwicket. The timing is off on the pull
into the pads, beats his inside edge, but goes for a wide down the leg side
flat length ball, punched to extra cover, Another dot, and the crowd gets restless
legbreak, worked off the pad for a single
the front-of-the-hand quick delivery. Pretty accurate. Jadeja hasn't seen this early enough to be able to play a productive shot. Finds midwicket
flighted outside off, flicks this back to Mishra
legbreak, gets extra bounce, hits the splice of the bat as Jadeja defends. His head rocks back too
sharp legbreak, but too short, and is easily punched down to long-on for one
wrong'un, he reads it, stays back, works it into the leg side, and runs hard to convert this one into two
the expected result. Tahir to bowl googly, Jadeja to not watch it closely, to get an edge. The edge, though, flies wide of slip. Just too thick an edge
length ball, on off, no turn, defended to leg
quick, flat, straight, worked into the leg side
flighted on middle and leg, uses his wrists to place it wide of long-on and comes back for a second
stays back to a flat legbreak, punches it, but can't beat point

short ball, Smith has sent it straight down the throat of deep midwicket. Coulter-Nile plays a part in yet another wicket. Just one of those shots, though. The ball deserves to be hit, but it has perhaps skidded on to him, and he is hurried into the pull. Easy catch for Coulter-Nile at deep midwicket
quicker, front-of-the-hand delivery, pushed into the leg side
googly, Smith doesn't pick it, is beaten on the inside edge, but the ball is headed down leg
flatter, out of the front of the hand, pushed to long-on for one
really slow legbreak, but short too. He waits for it, and then short-arms it to long-on
stays back to another length-ball legbreak, punches it to deep cover for one
on a length, legbreak, he stays back to work it into the leg side, and turns one into two
Is he dropped? I heard a sound as this googly passed the bat. Gautam hasn't collected this cleanly. No replays
flighted outside off, this is a half-volley, and Smith's driving arc sends it back over Tahir's head for four
fired in, on a length, no turn, no room, hits his pad. Headed down leg, though
short, on off, goes back to punch it into the leg side
short of a length, flat, on the pads, worked away for one
flighted on off, Smith plays for the turn, but the ball doesn't turn. Hits the inside half of the bat
makes room, gets under a length ball, chips it over extra cover for two
slower ball gone wrong, wide outside off
short of a length, wide delivery, he shuffles across, but ends up getting too close to it. Ends up pushing it straight to cover
short ball, not quick, not high, pulled away for a single
short of a length, worked into the leg side for one
short of a length, just outside off, punched away through extra cover for four
short of a length, angling in, worked into the leg side for one
top shot. Dances down the wicket, stays inside the line of a length ball, extends his arms through it, and chips it over extra cover
short of a length, wide, cut away to third man
short of a length, and again he can play the short-arm pull because of the lack of pace. Through midwicket it goes
full, angling in, dug out into the leg side for one
this one stops a bit at him, Smith hits it uppishly down to long-on for one
hit powerfully down the ground, but straight to mid-off

and Raina is bowled. Coulter-Nile has struck twice in two overs. Raina was pegged back first, then made to play defensive shots. And that's it. That is enough in T20 to create pressure that can make you play a low-percentage shot. And he just slogs already. The head falls away, is beaten, and the leg stump is pegged back
full, on off, Raina is caught deep in the crease, perhaps expecting a bouncer. Pushes in front of his body. To mid-off
short of a length, just outside off, defended towards cover
short of a length, on off, angles away, beats the tentative push from Raina. Gautam belts out an appeal for a catch, but he is the only one going up
quick sharp bouncer. This is a peach. From slightly fuller than halfway down the pitch it rears towards the head. Smith ducks it, and Gautam the keeper fails to collect it. Concedes the bye
half-volley, outside off, pushed wide of mid-off with an open face. Gets a single
solid front-foot defensive to end the over
length ball, into the pads, worked past short fine leg, they get a couple before Tahir can get around from deep square
takes the calculated risk. Banks on lack of pace with Joseph. Just short of a length, at 137ks, and he short-arm pulls this through midwicket for four
and he gets it to hold its line from wide on the crease, beating the edge. That's better bowling, and Smith is struggling immediately
that's a good comeback. Full, outside off, holds the line a touch, and beats the outside edge on the big attempted drive
and he strays down the leg side first ball. Smith has got four leg-byes, but he must be loving this standard of bowling after being tortured throughout the World Cup
short of a length, wide on the crease, angling across him, defended with an open face
angling in too far down the leg side, gets away with just a leg-bye
short of a length, at the pads, tucked away nicely into the vacant spaces on the leg side, takes three runs

slower ball, Smith makes room and swings hard, the edge flies back towards short third man where Yuvraj takes his second catch of the over. This one, though, won't bring them a wicket because this is a free hit
and this is a no-ball. The ball seams back in, and bounces a touch extra, hits him in the thigh pad, but this is going to be followed by a free hit

all right, this one hasn't cost Daredevils too much. Yuvraj gets a chance to make amends immediately. mcCullum charges at COulter-Nile who pulls the length back, and the top edge flies over the keeper's head. Yuvraj runs back to take an easy catch

that's catch drop No. 8 this IPL. Not even 40 overs in. McCullum is batting like he did in the World Cup, just swings at one without getting his eye in, and gets a thick edge, which bursts through the hands of Yuvraj Singh at first slip
this is closer to off, gives him less room, and Smith defends it back to him
Smith is on a roll here. Drives this wide length ball on the up. Into the ground it goes, and bounces over the fielder at cover for four more

superb on drive. Smith plants the front foot down a long way and drives this length ball between the bowler and mid-on. Shows what a difference it makes going from facing international bowlers in Australia and New Zealand to IPL bowlers in Chennai
and this one swings in too far again, and concedes four leg-byes this time
wide length ball, Smith just stands tall and drives on the up, past cover, all along the ground. Nowhere near the line of the ball but he has executed it superbly with his hands
some movement first up, beats the inside edge as it jags back in. Headed down leg

He misses by six feet. Bravo has played with fire here, but he has been lucky Morkel is exhausted. He has bowled six length balls to a man who loves length balls. Final ball is on a length too. It is outside off, he drives it hard, and in the air, and wide of long-off, but it falls six feet inside the rope
Raina has done really well here. Bravo continues bowling length, Morkel drives it over point, Raina gets across, gets a bad spinning bounce in the end, but saves two runs with his dive
this is poor bowling. Bravo has been getting away with this for far too length. Normal paced length ball after normal paced length ball. Morkel connects this time. Over midwicket for six
Tahir slogs, mis-ihts a length ball, he top-edges it to deep midwicket, and Tahir has done half his job of getting off strike, but has managed no run off it. Easy catch for Raina at deep midwicket
ordinary bowling again, but Morkel doesn't have any length left. Short ball, waist high, right in his slogging arc, but he mis-hits this to long-on, and he is off strike

lucky runs. Poor ball, though. Wide length ball, Morkel goes hard at it, gets a thick edge wide of the keeper, and he gets four. This might be the Franklin finish. Remember he once chased 20 in the last over with all mis-hits
Tahir swings, manages to beat mid-off with the mis-hit, comes back for the second
nearly a yorker outside off, Morkel hits hard but he can't mid-off. The single he takes is a lazy one, and McCullum's throw would have got him had he hit the stumps

poor from Mishra. Nehra bowls a bouncer, which is a wide, but Mishra is not looking at his parter who has rushed up for the bye that gives him the strike. Mishra is run out because a) he is a slow runner, and b) he is not alert to the run. Good presence of mind from Dhoni, lobbing the throw to Nehra
short of a length, he makes room to dab this to the left of point, right of third man, comes back for two
low full toss. He has erred on the full side, but he has a deep midwicket in place to keep this down to one
yorker from Nehra. "You still got it". Lovely delivery. Morkel is looking to open up the leg side, but the yorker gives him nothing. Morkel digs it out, but turns down the single
Mishra pushes this length ball to point and gives up. Other batsmen make this single easy, he has given up. Jadeja's throw misses, though, and they get the single
opens the face on this one, gets a single to point. Ashwin has tipped this game in Super Kings' favour in his last over
slow offbreak, wide outside off too, draws him wide,  Mishra defends

and Ashwin has that wicket. Coulter-Nile makes up his mind to slog-sweep, Ashwin fires one in full and fast, and it squeezes under the bat to knock the stumps back. Ashwin has again done the job for his captain. All down to former Super Kings player Morkel now for Daredevils
short of a length, punched down to long-on for one
backs away early, makes him fire one down leg, and then moves inside it to draw a wide. That's street-cricket batting
down the wicket, slogs, mis-hits wide of long-on, gets a second, Dhoni not happy with his fielder, Bravo
smart bowling. Morkel has been backing away, Ashwin follows him, cramps him up, draws a dot
short of a length, wide, punched away to deep cover for one

short and wide, slightly off pace, which means he gets a bottom edge, but that also means it goes slowly to deep midwicket, and he comes back for the second to bring up his fifty. He is on his haunches. It is hot and humid. He is tired, but he has a job to finish
length ball, angling in, worked to square leg in the circle, but they take a single
full and straight, driven down the ground, Bravo sticks his foot out, they take a single off the ricochet. He has saved three runs because mid-off was up
short of a length, angling away, beats this open face
Dhoni hasn't gone for this. Short and wide, he is lucky that Morkel has edged it, which is high to Dhoni's left, but not too high. You want to see your keeper go for these. Dhoni hasn't
length ball outside off, gets extra bounce, beats the edge as he looks to push
and he pulls the first ball he faces for four. Over midwicket. Just a soft short ball
Duminy has been running balls down to third man well, but Pandey has kept getting closer and closer to off. This time Duminy gets the inside edge onto the stumps. Huge wicket
short of a length, on off, runs this down towards third man, Jadeja's dive takes the pace off, which means they can take the second
shuffles across all the way to try a paddle. Gets a thick inside edge for one
short of a length, no room, but he still runs this down to third man for one
short of a length, outside off, runs this down to third man for one
full, outside off, driven to long-off for one
on a length, outside off, pushed wide of mid-off, gets the single that brings up their hundred

Yuvraj is not looking at the ball as he pulls. There has been a plan to bowl at his head, he has managed to keep it down twice, but this time he is late into the pull. The head falls away, he is not looking at it, and the ball comes and hits the bat as opposed to the hat hitting the ball. Easy catch for midwicket
full, angling across, Yuvraj goes for the cover-drive, and is beaten by the angle
looks to pull, mis-hits a skiddy delivery, gets a single to long-on
short and wide, too wide, another wide
another swat-pull from head high,. beats midwicket, keeps the pull down, gets a couple
loose ball. Just what Yuvraj needs early in the innings. On a length, pitched outside leg, and he has glanced it fine for four. Easy pickings
swat-pull as Sharma looks to bounce him. Yuvraj gets two in front of square
makes room again, he keeps it straight, cramps him up, concedes just the single on the pull
stylish defensive push off the front foot. Gets a single to the left of point

soft. Softest ever. Any softer and it would be wax. Jadhav looks like Duncan Fletcher giving catching practice to the slips and point. Just opens the face on a short and wide ball to give point an easy catch
Morkel backs away again, Bravo pushes one outside off, and beats his attyempt to cut. Morkel has lost his touch a little over the last few balls
short of a length, angling in, worked to leg for one
another mis-hit on a pull, but another top edge has not carried to midwicket
Morkel looks to make room and cut, but is beaten by a skiddy short ball
Jadhav gets lucky there. He walks at Bravo who bowls the effort bouncer, which gets big on Jadhav, but the edge beats midwicket
short and wide again, lucky to get away with just the single as he has cut this to the sweeper
Morkel backs away first up, Bravo looks to go wide outside off, but goes too wide
flicked to leg, this time McCullum fields well this time at short midwicket
makes room to smash this shortish ball straight to McCullum at short cover. He misfields to allow a single. A bit of a bad bounce really, which hits the top of his wrist and ricochets away for one
full and straight, pushed to long-on
Jadhav picks the length early against spin, and even though this is only slightly short, he has rocked back early and has enough time to pull this over midwicket. Excellent shot
quicker, flatter ball, cut away to deep cover for one
Morkel gives him the charge, Ashwin slows it down, Morkel recovers well to play the defensive shot
walks down at him, Pandey digs it in, draws some bounce, beats his cut
sends him the dummy. Shuffles across, and then backs away to cut this to deep cover for one
backs away again, Pandey bowls a low full toss on off, and is worked away wide of deep midwicket for two
backs away and looks to pull, but this ball doesn't quite come on and beats him for pace
short of a length, outside off, runs this down to third man for one
short and wide, Jadhav gets under it, and deliberately cuts it in the air to beat Jadeja at backward point. Daredevils looking in control of the chase
nicely worked away with the turn for a single. Jadhav looks assured playing spin
short again, and he is punched away for one
short ball, on off, he goes back and punches this in front of point. Nehra has made a stiff effort there. Doesn't dive. Dhoni wont be happy. Removes him from there
stays back to punch a length ball to backward point. Morel sets off for a run, is slow to come back, but has made sure he is back in by the time Dhoni flicks one into the stumps
punched to long-on for one
offbreak, flicked into the leg side, McCullum at midwicket goes the wrong way, and concedes two runs
whips a length ball away from outside off, gets a single to deep midwicket
short of a length, just outside off, beats the cut with extra bounce
slogged away from off, gets a thick inside edge for one
short and wide, but he has created distance as Morkel is backing away. The cut is not timed well, and finds point
lovely shot. Morkel has made room, Pandey has cramped him up, but he opens the face from in front of leg to guide this fine of third man for four
short of a length, outside off, he opens the face to run this down to third man for one
slightly short, Jadhav goes back to cut, but the ball turns back in sharply, which means he gets just a single after being cramped up
pushed to mid-on with soft hands, sneaks in a single
short of a length, on off, stops on him, defended to off
lovely bowling. Morkel is shaping up for a slog, Ashwin bowls slower through the air, a traditional offbreak, and Morkel lets it go at the last moment. Misses the off stump by a whisker
works an offbreak into the leg side for a single
short of a length, a bit of a loosener, punched to long-on for one
full, just outside off, driven straight of mid-off for a single
slightly off pace as Morkel makes room again, and he beats him for pace
bouncer, pitched outside leg, pulled between deep square leg and deep midwicket. Keeps it down. Gets a couple
backs away again, Pandey bowls outside off, and the extra bounce beats his cut
looks to pull, times it well, but finds midwicket

that's lucky. Morkel takes the risk first ball, backing away and swinging at a wide delivery. Pandey has actually done well because he has seen Morkel back away. But Morkel goes at it, and gets an edge that goes fine of third man
slower ball, Jadhav swings wildly, and is beaten by the movement away
works this to leg from just outside off, finds midwicket this time
wide length ball, he drives on the up, but can't beat point
looks for the slog. All it takes is two dot balls for the low-percentage shot to come out. The bottom edge gets him a single
short of a length, no room, pushed to point again
short of a length, no room, punched away, but straight to backward point

this is not the smartest bit of batting. He has fallen to an old little trap from Dhoni. More experienced/better batsmen do better. After that four first ball, Dhoni has guessed off side is Iyer's game, and has placed a deep point and opened the third man region. The next three balls: a slog into the leg side, an attempt to open the face, and another slog. This slog goes a mile in the air and settles with du Plessis at extra cover. You have got to make them work harder for your wickets
this time he looks at the third man, but Nehra is too close too his body to let him open the face. Hits his glove after cramping him up
first dot for Iyer, and it comes from a bit of a slog. This shot is a reaction to the field placement. Gets an inside edge to mid-on
short of a length, just outside off, runs this down to third man for one
closer to his body, Iyer, pushes this wide of mid-off for a single this time. Iyer yet to face a dot ball
Iyer takes a risk but this is a high-percentage shot. He goes with Nehra's angle and chips this over cover. Not the most powerful of hits, but his intention is to just clear the ring
shot. Morkel looks in good batting form. This is on a length, angling away from him, and he pushes this on the up, with an open face, wide of mid-off, gets four. Lovely timing yet again
bouncer, wide down the leg side
short of a length, outside off, for some reason Iyer looks to whip this to leg, gets a thick leading edge that gets him a single
lovely shot, and equally good fielding. Morkel rocks back to punch this length ball square on the off side. Jadeja flies to his left at point to save three runs
short ball, not a great idea at Mohit's pace. Morkel sits back, waits for it to arrive, and pulls this in front of square for four
length ball, angling in, pushed wide of mid-on to get off the mark first ball
short ball, into the ribs, Morkel's eye is off the ball as he fends this into the leg side for one

and Nehra has taken out the openers in one over. Agarwal tries one shot too many. Nehra has run his fingers on this. Slightly off-pace with another forceful shot, and he is early into it. The outside edge is taken by Dhoni
top shot. Agarwal can pack a punch. He definitely has here. This is a length ball, wide, and he drives on the up, square through the off side. Four all along the ground
on a length, angling in, bunted into the leg side for a single

and Nehra has won the early contest. Gautam never looked comfortable against him, trying to manufacture shots. Yet again he tries a shot that is not on. Looks to go over mid-on, but this length ball is too close to him, and he has sent this straight down mid-on's throat. Nehra blows him a kiss as he walks off. Love is in the air
looks to shuffle all the way across and try the paddle over fine leg, but Nehra keeps going across with him, and he plays it into his own body
risky shot. Shuffles across to cover the movement, and mis-hits it over mid-off for two
another similar preparation, but this time he keeps it along the carpet, and finds mid-off
lovely shot. Inside-out. Just a chip. Confident of playing the shot against Mohit's pace. Presses the front foot down, gets under a length ball, and chips it over mid-off
shuffles across to push a wide length ball between mid-off and cover for one
uppish again. This time with the cut, but he has hit it left enough of the diving Raina at backward point
uppish as he drives hard at a length ball that doesn't quite come on. Bounces just short of mid-on
he moves across first ball and whips this from around off to long leg. Not a high-percentage shot
down the wicket again, this time the swing from Nehra beats his inside edge and hits his pad. he is down the wicket so there is no shout for lbw
pretty straight, no room, defended back to him
walks down to a length ball to overcome that early swing, and he whips this from outside off through midwicket for four. That is a risk taken after three balls, but well played at it
more shape back in from Nehra, he defends it in front of off
short of a length, again some shape back in, pushed to cover. No room
slight swing first up, beats his attempt to drive a length ball
